# xtra

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

xtra provides a growing collection of extra utility functions for R.
It currently includes:

* `read_excel_multi_headers()` reads Excel files with multiple header rows
  and merged cells.
* `save_plot()` saves any plot to disk.
* `docx_add_img()` adds images with optional captioning to Word documents.

## Installation

You can install the development version of xtra from
[GitHub](https://github.com/NourEdinDarwish/xtra) with:

```r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("NourEdinDarwish/xtra")
```
